name: Shibari Shinpu
source:
For a certain reason, Kido and I ended up moving to Shirene Village—a place far from the city, surrounded by nature.
The villagers welcomed us warmly and were kind… but something about them felt off.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/14807]freem[/url]]
